answer: Here is one mechanism that works: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because beacon only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, sonnet is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any horizon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
